test_objective: Check that you can delete a context source registration by id

test_cases.name: 035_01_01 Delete a context source registration by id
test_cases.doc: Check that you can delete a context source registration by id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations/{context_source_registration_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with data: and
    Query Parameter: context source registration id set to '${registration_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
